infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TaxTrack uses your location to automatically log which tax jurisdiction you are in for compliance tracking.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TaxTrack uses your background location to log your jurisdiction every 5 minutes throughout the day, even when the app is not open. This is required for accurate tax day counting.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: TaxTrack uses your background location to log your jurisdiction every 5 minutes for tax compliance tracking.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TaxTrack uses your camera to capture photos of boarding passes, hotel confirmations, and other travel evidence.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TaxTrack accesses your photo library to let you attach photos of travel documents as evidence.
